title: A machine-checked proof of Feige's inequality for all δ > 0 (Lean 4)
description: Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Feige's small-deviation inequality for every δ > 0. Let X_1,...,X_n be independent, nonnegative and integrable with E[X_i] ≤ μ. Then P(Σ X_i − E Σ X_i < δμ) ≥ min(δ/(1+δ), 1/e). The proof follows Z. Ling, On Samuels' Conjecture (arXiv:2608.18392). Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.
